title: Stock futures rise as Nvidia shares gain over 4% after earnings: Live updates
summary: Nvidia shares jumped over 4% following earnings that exceeded analyst expectations, lifting stock futures higher. The strong performance reflects investor confidence in the chipmaker's revenue and growth trajectory.
content: Investors looked at the earnings report from Nvidia, which surpassed analyst forecasts.

zh.title: 英伟达股价在财报后上涨超4%，股指期货上升：实时更新
zh.summary: 英伟达股价在超出分析师预期的财报公布后上涨超4%，推高股指期货。这一强劲表现反映了投资者对这家芯片制造商收入和增长轨迹的信心。

title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, report says
summary: Nvidia is reportedly acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, marking a major move to expand its presence in the AI software ecosystem. The deal would position Nvidia deeper into both AI development tools and the broader artificial intelligence landscape.
content: Nvidia reportedly agreed to buy open source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as the chipmaker expands deeper into the AI ecosystem.

zh.title: 报道称英伟达同意以129亿美元收购Hugging Face
zh.summary: 报道称英伟达正在以129亿美元收购开源人工智能平台Hugging Face，这是扩展其在人工智能软件生态系统中影响力的重大举措。该交易将使英伟达更深入地进入人工智能开发工具和更广泛的人工智能领域。

title: CIA chief John Ratcliffe reportedly made secretive Moscow trip to warn Russia against attacking NATO
summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe reportedly made a secretive trip to Moscow to warn Russia against attacking NATO, amid escalating drone and missile strikes between Russia and Ukraine. The mission underscores U.S. efforts to prevent further conflict escalation.
content: Russia and Ukraine have intensified long-range drone and missile strikes as fears of further escalation grow.

zh.title: 据报道美国中情局局长拉特克利夫进行秘密莫斯科之行，警告俄罗斯不要攻击北约
zh.summary: 据报道美国中情局局长约翰·拉特克利夫进行了秘密莫斯科之行以警告俄罗斯不要攻击北约，背景是俄罗斯和乌克兰之间无人机和导弹袭击不断升级。这次任务强调了美国阻止进一步冲突升级的努力。

title: Bank of Korea delivers back-to-back rate hikes as core inflation stays elevated
summary: South Korea's central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 3%, the highest level since January 2025, as core inflation remains elevated. The rate hike aligns with market expectations and reflects efforts to control price pressures.
content: The Bank of Korea hiked rates by 25 basis points to 3%, its highest since January 2025 and in line with expectations.

zh.title: 韩国央行追加加息，核心通胀居高不下
zh.summary: 韩国央行将利率上调25个基点至3%，创下2025年1月以来的最高水平，因为核心通胀仍然保持高位。此次加息符合市场预期，反映了央行控制价格压力的努力。

title: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on Chinese chips
summary: Chinese AI company Z.ai's shares surged 8% after launching a new AI model that runs exclusively on Chinese chips. The model had been operating globally in stealth mode for a week before the public announcement.
content: The Chinese AI company said it had already launched the model globally in stealth mode for a week.

zh.title: Z.ai股价在发布仅支持中国芯片的新型AI模型后上涨8%
zh.summary: 中国人工智能公司Z.ai在推出专门运行中国芯片的新型AI模型后，股价上涨8%。该模型在公开宣布前已在全球范围内以隐蔽模式运行了一周。

title: Tanker attack tests Trump’s claim that Hormuz is a 'functioning strait'
summary: An oil tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, maintaining concerns about shipping risks in this critical energy corridor. The incident highlights ongoing tensions affecting global oil transport routes.
content: An oil tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, keeping alive risks deterring vessesl from the vital energy corridor.

zh.title: 油轮遇袭考验特朗普关于荷美兹海峡是"正常运作"的说法
zh.summary: 一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡遭不明物体击中，使人们对这条关键能源走廊的航运风险保持警惕。这起事件突显了影响全球石油运输线路的持续紧张局势。

title: Qantas shares jump after earnings as airline unveils new business-class seats
summary: Qantas shares rose 4% after reporting strong full-year earnings and unveiling new business-class seats amid robust demand for premium air travel. The airline's performance reflects broader strength in the aviation sector.
content: Qantas shares jumped 4% after the airline reported full-year earnings and introduced new business-class seats amid strong demand for premium travel.

zh.title: 澳航股价在公布业绩后上升，同时推出新商务舱座位
zh.summary: 澳航在公布强劲的全年业绩和推出新商务舱座位后股价上涨4%，这是在对高端空运需求强劲的背景下发生的。该航空公司的表现反映了航空业的广泛增长。

title: Europe’s gas stores are running low — and prices could top 100 euros this winter
summary: Europe's natural gas reserves have fallen to historically low levels for this time of year as disrupted Middle East LNG flows reduce supply. Prices risk exceeding 100 euros this winter if shortages persist.
content: Europe’s gas stores are historically low for this time of year, as disrupted Middle East LNG flows raise the risk of sharply higher prices this winter.

zh.title: 欧洲天然气储备正在耗尽 —— 今年冬天价格可能会超过100欧元
zh.summary: 由于中东液化天然气流量中断导致供应减少，欧洲天然气储备已下降到这个时期的历史最低水平。如果短缺持续，今年冬天价格有可能超过100欧元。

title: Japanese startups, IPOs set for boost with platform to trade unlisted companies
summary: Japan's financial regulator approved a new trading platform for unlisted company shares, potentially improving capital-raising opportunities for startups and IPO candidates. The initiative aims to strengthen the country's venture ecosystem.
content: The Japanese regulator's registration of a new trading platform for unlisted shares could help create a more favorable capital-raising environment for the country's IPO ecosystem.

zh.title: 日本初创企业和IPO将受益于未上市公司交易平台的推出
zh.summary: 日本金融监管机构批准了一个新的未上市公司股份交易平台，这可能会改善初创企业和IPO候选企业的融资机会。该举措旨在加强日本的创业生态系统。

title: China industrial profits growth cools to slowest in seven months as economic slowdown deepens
summary: China's industrial profit growth slowed to its weakest pace in seven months during July as soft demand and broader economic slowdown pressured manufacturers. The cooling reflects wider challenges facing China's economy.
content: China's industrial profits growth in July slowed to its weakest pace this year, as soft demand and a broader slowdown in the economy weighed on manufacturers.

zh.title: 中国工业利润增长创七个月新低，经济放缓加剧
zh.summary: 由于需求疲软和经济放缓压力加大，中国七月工业利润增速创七个月来最低。这种冷却反映了中国经济面临的更广泛挑战。

title: What to know about Hugging Face, the open-source AI startup reportedly catching Nvidia’s eye
summary: Reports highlight ongoing deal talks between Nvidia and open-source AI platform Hugging Face as companies vie for control of foundational AI technology. Open-source AI tools are becoming increasingly strategic in the competitive artificial intelligence market.
content: New reports outline deal talks between the two companies as open-source AI technology comes more into focus.

zh.title: Hugging Face需了解的事项：这家开源AI初创公司据称吸引英伟达关注
zh.summary: 报告强调了英伟达与开源AI平台Hugging Face之间正在进行的交易谈判，公司争夺基础AI技术控制权。在竞争激烈的人工智能市场中，开源AI工具正变得越来越具有战略意义。

title: Salesforce stock jumps 12% on AI growth and Anthropic investment gain
summary: Salesforce shares jumped 12% after reporting strong AI-driven growth and a profitable gain from its investment stake in AI company Anthropic. The results demonstrate the company's successful AI strategy and diversified revenue model.
content: Salesforce's Anthropic stake led to higher profit in the latest quarter.

zh.title: Salesforce股价因AI业务增长和Anthropic投资收益上涨12%
zh.summary: Salesforce公布了强劲的AI驱动增长和从Anthropic投资中获得的利润后，股价上涨了12%。这些成果体现了该公司成功的AI战略和多元化的收入模式。

title: CrowdStrike’s stock soars after AI fuels the cybersecurity company’s ‘best quarter in history’
summary: CrowdStrike shares surged following the cybersecurity company's best quarter on record, partly boosted by customer demand driven by AI security concerns. The strong results suggest AI is becoming a business driver for the sector.
content: Shares of CrowdStrike Holdings were roaring after the cybersecurity company revealed a record-breaking quarter, one partially boosted by fears about the power of artificial intelligence.

zh.title: AI推动下CrowdStrike股价飙升，该网络安全公司迎来"历史最佳季度"
zh.summary: CrowdStrike股票在该公司创造历史最佳季度后飙升，部分得益于由AI安全需求驱动的客户需求增加。强劲的业绩表明AI正成为该行业的业务驱动力。

title: CrowdStrike's quarter shows AI is a cybersecurity tailwind, not a threat
summary: CrowdStrike's record quarter demonstrates that advances in artificial intelligence are benefiting rather than threatening cybersecurity companies, contradicting earlier bearish predictions. The results suggest AI poses a business opportunity rather than an existential risk.
content: Earlier this year, the bears thought advances in AI models could disintermediate the cybersecurity sector. So far, they've been proven wrong.

zh.title: CrowdStrike季度成绩显示AI是网络安全的利好，而非威胁
zh.summary: CrowdStrike创纪录的季度成绩表明人工智能的进步正在惠及而非威胁网络安全公司，这与早前的看空预测相反。业绩结果表明AI是商业机遇而非生存风险。

title: Fed Gov Lisa Cook’s lawyer fires back at Trump's renewed threat to oust her
summary: The lawyer for Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook responded to Trump's renewed threats to remove her from office, following the Supreme Court's June ruling that blocked his first removal attempt. The Court left open a legal pathway for Trump to pursue removal through alternative means.
content: The Supreme Court in late June blocked Trump from firing Cook from the Federal Reserve, but left the president with a path to try again to remove her.

zh.title: 美联储主席Lisa Cook的律师回击特朗普驱赶她的新威胁
zh.summary: 美联储主席Lisa Cook的律师对特朗普最近提出的将其赶出办公室的威胁作出回应，这发生在最高法院6月裁定阻止他首次撤销尝试之后。法院为特朗普留下了通过替代手段寻求撤销的法律途径。
